decision.summary: Denied. The claim description is addressed to Emma Fischer while using first-person “I,” and the booking identifies Emma Fischer as the lead passenger, making the claim self-addressed and inconsistent with the other documents.
decision.explanation: Dear Emma Fischer, we have reviewed your claim description and the attached booking confirmation. The claim description begins, “Hi, Emma Fischer,” and then says, “I decided not to go to Copenhagen on 15 March 2025 after all,” while the booking confirmation identifies Emma Fischer as the lead passenger. This makes the claim self-addressed and inconsistent with the other documents in the file. Because of that inconsistency, we cannot accept the claim as submitted, and the claim is denied.
